name: Sanctions Desk
summary: An AI review desk for bank sanctions-screening alerts. For every alert it reads the evidence through Zetaris, compares the parties under approved definitions, asks NVIDIA Nemotron models through Meterless Nightshift for a recommendation, re-reads every cited fact, applies a written policy and hands a recommendation with its evidence to a person. It recommends; automatic closing is off by default and was off in every recorded run, so a person makes the final call.

agents.role: plans the review path and grades how hard the case is
reads every fact through the Zetaris semantic layer under its own role
screens free text from the data for instructions aimed at the reviewer, and checks drafts for a customer against the tipping-off policy
reads customer notes, payment references and list remarks for risk no structured field shows
compares names, dates of birth, countries and identifiers with the listed party
writes the ownership register into the World Model and evaluates the 50 percent rule (a cascade) on it
recalls earlier decisions about the same pair (H-MEM engine)
recommends one of four outcomes with cited facts
agents.model: mostly Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, cloud, via Nightshift

agents.role: looks for claims the evidence does not support, after code re-reads every cited fact; at most 3 rounds
agents.model: mostly Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, cloud, via Nightshift

agents.role: argues the case against a close that could slip through
agents.model: mostly Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, cloud, via Nightshift

agents.role: applies the active written policy and the hard limits

data_platform.name: Zetaris
data_platform.role: the only data path: agents send one read-only SQL statement at a time to the Zetaris REST API, under one read-only Zetaris role per data-reading step (when its token is configured), with per-agent allow-lists and data-quality rules
sources: semantic layer over the public list files (OFAC, UN)
Postgres synthetic bank database via JDBC

zetaris.role: only data path: one semantic layer over list files, a Postgres bank database (JDBC) and a payments REST service

uses.World Model: the ownership register the 50 percent rule is evaluated on

meterless_nightshift.provider: primary model provider for every model call (OpenAI-compatible runtime); Ollama is the backup
meterless_nightshift.role: all model calls through pinned modes with signed receipts
meterless_nightshift.signed_receipts: each call's signed receipt is stored with the decision record and in the trace; check them with npm run evidence:verify

nvidia_nemotron.role: safety guard and screener (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B, local), decision, critic and challenger (mostly Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, cloud), via Nightshift; the model ledger and signed receipts show which model answered each step

sample_mode.needs: nothing: no Zetaris, no Nightshift, no credentials
sample_mode.what_runs: the real agent logic on saved answers from real Zetaris queries, with a labelled rules-based stand-in for the models

user_interface.stack: Next.js; a person approves or overrides with a reason, a block, or an override to a close, needs two approvers; works in sample mode

data: real public list entries (OFAC SDN, OFAC consolidated and UN consolidated, Oct 2026; 365 in Zetaris after a labelled synthetic update to 6 of them, 5 edited and 1 removed) plus synthetic customers, accounts, owners, alerts and payments
coding_tool: Claude Code (scaffolding, tests, debugging and documentation; all generated code reviewed and tested; Cursor was not used)
ai_usage: Built with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude Code). Product models are NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift.
